name: Overnight Oats with Berries
description: Oats soaked overnight in milk and yoghurt, topped with berries in the morning.
steps: Mix oats, milk, yoghurt, chia seeds and maple syrup in two jars.
Refrigerate overnight.
Top with berries before serving.

name: Yoghurt Granola Bowl
description: Greek yoghurt with crunchy granola, fresh fruit and a drizzle of honey.
steps: Divide the yoghurt over two bowls.
Top with fruit, granola and honey.

name: Scrambled Eggs on Sourdough
description: Soft, buttery scrambled eggs with chives on toasted sourdough.
steps: Whisk the eggs with milk, salt and pepper.
Cook gently in butter over low heat, stirring, until just set.
Pile onto hot toast and scatter with chives.

name: Avocado Toast with Poached Egg
description: Smashed avocado with lime and chilli on sourdough, topped with a poached egg.
steps: Mash the avocado with lime juice, salt and pepper.
Poach the eggs in barely simmering water with the vinegar for 3 minutes.
Toast the bread, spread with avocado, top with egg and chilli flakes.

name: Apple Cinnamon Porridge
description: Creamy oat porridge with grated apple, cinnamon and walnuts.
steps: Simmer the oats with the milk and half of the apple for 5 minutes, stirring.
Stir in cinnamon and maple syrup.
Serve topped with the rest of the apple and walnuts.

name: Banana Oat Pancakes
description: Thick, naturally sweet pancakes made from banana, oats and egg.
steps: Blend bananas, eggs, oats, baking powder and cinnamon into a thick batter.
Fry small pancakes in butter, 2 minutes per side.
Serve with blueberries and maple syrup.

name: French Toast
description: Wentelteefjes: day-old bread soaked in vanilla-cinnamon custard and fried in butter.
steps: Whisk eggs, milk, vanilla sugar and cinnamon in a shallow dish.
Soak the bread briefly on both sides.
Fry in butter until golden, 2 minutes per side. Sprinkle with brown sugar.

name: Ham and Cheese Omelette
description: Fluffy three-egg omelette with ham, cheese and chives.
steps: Beat the eggs with salt and pepper.
Pour into foaming butter and stir gently until almost set.
Add ham, cheese and chives, fold and slide onto a plate.

name: Mango Chia Pudding
description: Coconut chia pudding layered with fresh mango. Make it the night before.
steps: Stir chia seeds into the coconut milk, milk and maple syrup. Stir again after 10 minutes.
Refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.
Layer with mango in glasses.

name: Soft-Boiled Eggs with Toast Soldiers
description: The weekend breakfast: runny eggs with buttered toast strips.
steps: Lower the eggs into boiling water and cook for 6 minutes.
Toast and butter the bread and cut into strips.
Serve the eggs in egg cups with salt and the soldiers.

name: Shakshuka
description: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce, with bread for dipping.
steps: Soften onion and peppers in olive oil for 10 minutes. Add garlic and spices.
Add the tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes until thick. Season.
Make six hollows, crack in the eggs, cover and cook 6 to 8 minutes until the whites are set.
Crumble over the feta and coriander. Serve with bread.

name: Ham and Cheese Smos
description: Belgian sandwich-shop classic: baguette with ham, cheese, egg, salad and mayonnaise.
steps: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool and slice.
Halve the baguette and slice open. Spread with butter and mayonnaise.
Fill with lettuce, ham, cheese, tomato, cucumber and egg.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
description: Romaine with grilled chicken, croutons, Parmesan and a creamy anchovy-free dressing.
steps: Season the chicken and pan-fry in 1 tbsp oil for 6 minutes per side. Rest and slice.
Toss the bread cubes in the remaining oil and bake at 200 °C for 8 minutes.
Whisk mayonnaise, lemon juice, garlic, mustard and Worcestershire sauce with a little water.
Toss the lettuce with dressing and top with chicken, croutons and Parmesan.

name: Greek Salad
description: Tomato, cucumber, pepper, olives and feta with oregano and olive oil.
steps: Combine the vegetables and olives in a bowl.
Top with the feta in one piece, sprinkle with oregano and drizzle with oil and vinegar.
Serve with warm pita.

name: Club Sandwich
description: Triple-decker toast with chicken, bacon, egg, lettuce and tomato.
steps: Pan-fry the seasoned chicken and slice. Fry the bacon until crisp. Fry the eggs.
Toast the bread and spread with mayonnaise.
Layer: toast, lettuce, tomato, chicken, toast, bacon, egg, toast. Cut into triangles and serve with crisps.

name: Leek and Potato Soup
description: Silky blended leek and potato soup, ready in half an hour.
steps: Soften the leeks and onion in butter for 8 minutes.
Add the potatoes, stock cubes and 1.2 litres water. Simmer 20 minutes.
Blend smooth, add cream and season. Garnish with chives.

name: Couscous Salad with Feta and Mint
description: Lunchbox salad of couscous, cucumber, tomato, chickpeas, feta and fresh herbs.
steps: Pour 300 ml boiling salted water over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes and fluff with a fork.
Mix in the chickpeas, vegetables and herbs.
Dress with lemon juice and olive oil, season and top with feta.

name: Salade Niçoise
description: Tuna, egg, green beans, potatoes, tomatoes and olives with a mustard vinaigrette.
steps: Boil the potatoes, adding the beans for the last 4 minutes. Boil the eggs for 8 minutes.
Whisk mustard, vinegar and oil into a dressing.
Arrange lettuce, halved potatoes, beans, tomatoes, quartered eggs, tuna and olives. Drizzle with the dressing.
